title: Molaetsa oa Moroallo o Moholo
intro: Motho enoa o ile a ema e le tšiea ea mamello ka makholo a lilemo, a bitsa sechaba se hanyetsang ho ea leseling la 'nete ha a ntse a tobane le ho songoa le ho lahloa. Ho sa tsotellehe mathata a maholo le boima ba molaetsa o akaretsang meloko, mohlanka enoa o ile a lula a tiile thomong ea hae ho fihlela taelo ea ho qetela e ntšoa.
clues: Ke qetile lilemo tse makholo a robong le mashome a mahlano ke bitsetsa batho ba ka tseleng ea ho loka, motšehare le bosiu, sephiring le phatlalatsa.
Ke lemositse batho ba ka ka kotlo e bohloko, empa ba ipeile menwana ditsebeng mme ba ikapesa ka diaparo tsa bona ka boikakaso.
Ke ile ka laeloa ho haha ​​ntho e khōlō tlas'a mahlo a Morena oa ka, leha ho ne ho se na metsi a bonahalang.
Ha ke ntse ke sebetsa, baetapele ba batho ba heso ba ne ba feta mme ba ntsheha, empa ke ile ka ba bolella hore haufinyane re tla ba soma.
Ke ile ka kopa hore nama le mali a ka a ikopanye le 'na, empa ba ile ba khetha ho batla setšabelo thabeng, ba lumela hore e tla ba pholosa maqhubung a ntseng a phahama.
Sekepe sa ka qetellong se ile sa ema Thabeng ea Judi ka mor'a hore lefatše le metse metsi a lona 'me leholimo le khaotse ho na.

arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
